title: Revealing the dynamic network structure of the Beck Depression Inventory-II
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Limited to clinical population; - BDI-II may not capture differences between therapies; - No person-specific network analysis due to computational constraints
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly declared in the paper. The authors note that person-specific network analysis is computationally infeasible for large networks at the time of publication.
